about: Each fact this skill states in its own words, with the page that states it and a phrase that page must still carry. No checker ships with this skill: re-check each by hand against its page; when one fails, re-read the page and correct the skill and this line together.

facts.claim: the module boundary is the only bullet-proof scope for unsafe
Miri runs no FFI by default; its native-lib flag is experimental and this standard does not rely on it
arch intrinsics are unsafe unless the target feature is enabled
#[bench] is nightly and harness can be turned off
a map over a file modified underneath is undefined behavior
the perf book names the profilers
criterion says not to rely on benchmark results in CI
calling a function compiled with an unsupported target feature is undefined behavior
facts.phrase: undefined behavior to call a function

facts.claim: no_std swaps the std prelude for core
overflow checks are a profile setting a package can override
memchr loses run-time CPU detection without std
simdutf8 disables run-time selection under target-cpu=native
tokio pins its Miri nightly by date

watch.what: a virtual workspace root must set the resolver
a missing edition field means the 2015 edition
transcendental float functions vary by platform
wasm32-unknown-unknown has no threads and aborts on panic
line-tables-only is the minimal debug info for file and line backtraces
Cargo disables incremental compilation by default in CI
watch.pattern: disabled by default when running in CI
watch.value: disabled by default when running in CI

watch.what: Cargo advises one integration test crate split into modules when there are many
